nodes.label: Diphthong-Aware Diacritic Transfer Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: A source already marked in Bosworth-Toller diphthong style was being double-marked because each vowel was transferred separately.

nodes.label: DiacriticTransfer.mark_pattern
nodes.rationale: The reference form decides diphthongs ea, eo, ie, and io; only macrons merge onto the first vowel, and a breve in a loanword stays a hiatus.

nodes.label: _Letter parse model
nodes.rationale: Transfer stays additive: source letters, case, and existing marks are never removed, and a mark is added only when the source diphthong has no marks yet.
